speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history. To better understand the progression of your gait and limb ataxia, have you noticed any specific triggers for your symptoms, such as standing up quickly or exposure to certain chemicals?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any sudden onset of numbness, weakness, or visual disturbances in your right arm or leg, such as drooping or inability to move?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: PML (Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy) secondary to natalizumab use.

I am requesting the results of your recent MRI of the brain immediately. REQUEST IMAGES: Brain_MRI_with_contrast. Please also confirm if you have experienced any recent changes in vision or memory since starting the medication.
